header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Endure Hardships and difficulties when Giving Da'wah towards Allaah

blocks.text: Khabbaab (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) replied, "He is Bilaal (RA)." Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) said, "He is really not more deserving than me because there were people amongst the Mushrikeen whom Allaah used to protect him while there was none to protect me. I had seen myself on a day when they captured me, lit a fire and then put me to roast in it. A man then placed his foot on my chest and there was only my back to extinguish the fire." Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) then exposed his back which seemed to be affected by leprosy.[^1]
The Torture that Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) Suffered

Imaam Sha'bi narrates that when Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) about the tortures he suffered at the hands of the Mushrikeen, he said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! Take a look at my back." Hadhrat Umar (RA) says, "I have never before seen anything like it." Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) then related, "They made a fire for me and (after throwing me in) there was nothing but the fat on my back to extinguish it."[^2]

Hadhrat Abu Layla Kindi narrates that when Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) came to Hadhrat Umar (RA), Hadhrat Umar (RA) told the people to allow him to come to the front and said, "Besides Ammaar bin Yaasir, there is none on the surface of this earth who deserves to occupy this place more than you." It was on that occasion that Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) showed Hadhrat Umar (RA) the scars on his back that were made by the torture that Mushrikeen put him through.[^3]

Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) says, "I was a blacksmith and Aas bin Waa'il owed me some money. When I approached him to settle the debt, he said, 'By Allaah! I shall never pay you until you reject Muhammad!' I responded by saying, 'Never! I swear by Allaah that I shall never reject Muhammad ﷺ even after you die and are resurrected!' He said, "Then come to me after I have died and am resurrected. There I shall have plenty of wealth and children and I shall then pay you.'" It was then that Allaah revealed the following verses of the Qur'aan:

blocks.arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِيْ كَفَرَ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوْتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَّ وَلَدًا ۞ أَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمٰنِ عَهْدًا ۞ كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُوْلُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهٗ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّا ۞ وَّنَرِثُهٗ مَا يَقُوْلُ وَيَأْتِيْنَا فَرْدًا ۞
blocks.text: Have you seen him who rejects Our Aayaat and says, "I shall certainly be granted (abundant) wealth and children (in the Aakhirah just as I have them in this world)." Has he peeked into the unseen or has he made a pact with Ar Rahmaan (because of which he seems convinced of this)? Never! We shall shortly record what he says and continue to intensify the punishment for him (in the Aakhirah). (On the Day of
